data.question: count all doctors
data.generatedSql: SELECT count(*) AS `Total Doctors` FROM doctors WHERE is_deleted = false

data.question: list all cardiology doctors
data.generatedSql: SELECT d.first_name AS `First Name`, d.last_name AS `Last Name`, d.email AS `Email` FROM doctors d JOIN doctor_specialties_map m ON m.doctor_id = d.id JOIN specialties s ON s.id = m.specialty_id WHERE d.is_deleted = false AND s.name = 'Cardiology'

data.question: list all patients
data.generatedSql: SELECT first_name AS `First Name`, last_name AS `Last Name`, email AS `Email` FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = false

data.question: list doctor availability timing
data.generatedSql: SELECT d.first_name AS `First Name`, d.last_name AS `Last Name`, av.day_of_week AS `Day`, av.start_time AS `Starts`, av.end_time AS `Ends` FROM doctor_availabilities av JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id WHERE av.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false ORDER BY d.first_name, av.day_of_week

data.question: which doctors are available today
data.generatedSql: SELECT d.first_name AS `First Name`, d.last_name AS `Last Name`, av.start_time AS `Starts`, av.end_time AS `Ends` FROM doctor_availabilities av JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id WHERE av.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false AND av.day_of_week = UPPER(DAYNAME(CURDATE()))

data.question: how many days does each doctor work
data.generatedSql: SELECT d.first_name AS `First Name`, d.last_name AS `Last Name`, COUNT(*) AS `Working Days` FROM doctor_availabilities av JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id WHERE av.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name ORDER BY `Working Days` DESC

data.question: total weekly working hours for each doctor
data.generatedSql: SELECT d.first_name AS `First Name`, d.last_name AS `Last Name`, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, av.start_time, av.end_time) - COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, av.break_start_time, av.break_end_time), 0)) / 60 AS `Weekly Hours` FROM doctor_availabilities av JOIN doctors d ON d.id = av.doctor_id WHERE av.is_deleted = false AND d.is_deleted = false GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name ORDER BY `Weekly Hours` DESC
